title: Replace Salesforce: Build Your Own CRM With AI in an Afternoon
summary: Salesforce charges $250/month for 10 users and your team uses 20% of the features. Here's how teams build a custom CRM with AI in an afternoon — database and auth included.
body_markdown: First: audit which integrations your team actually uses versus which ones are just connected. Most small teams actively use 1-3. Email logging, calendar sync, and data enrichment tools can be connected via API in Blink. Deep integrations like Marketo, SAP, Docusign, or CPQ tools are harder to replicate — those are the real cases where Salesforce's AppExchange ecosystem justifies the cost. Be honest about whether you use them.
